title: PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT can read or modify rows despite auto-updatable view WHERE condition (CVE-2026-16237)
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL's INSERT ... ON CONFLICT functionality on auto-updatable views allows attackers with INSERT and UPDATE privileges on the view to bypass the view's WHERE condition and read or modify all rows in the base table. This affects versions prior to 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7.
